inputParameters.name: filter
inputParameters.description: Optionally, filter for specific technologies or categories. You can enter a list of desired technologies or categories separated by commas. If you put a word in quotes (i.e. "Java"), it will do an exact match and will not return things like "Javascript".

inputParameters.name: dateFilter
inputParameters.description: Optionally, filter by the date a technology was last detected. You can use relative dates like "5 days ago", or a date like "2022-07-31" (yyyy-MM-dd).

inputParameters.name: exactTechnologyMatch
inputParameters.description: If switched on, we will only return technologies that have a name that exactly matches one of your keywords

inputParameters.name: includeDescriptionInKeywordMatch
inputParameters.description: If switched on, when Filtering by Keyword or Category, we will check the description of the technnology for any matches.
inputParameters.displayName: Use Description in Keyword or Category Match?

inputParameters.name: showAdditionalFields
inputParameters.description: If switched on, we will return additional fields like the first + last detected date, tags, and whether the technology is premium.

suggestedFieldPathFilters.description: Extract the list of technologies in a single field separated by commas
